The '''Frostwake Hills''' were located at the western edge of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Frostwake Outpost]] was built into the hills, with the base's entrance overlooking the [[Glacial Fissure]]'s [[Eruption Impasse]], and the [[Grim Path]] ran through the hills.
